test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sohan starts from his home and cycles 2 kilometres on a straight road. Then he turns left and cycles 5 kilometres to reach a square. From the square, again he takes a left and covers 2 kilometres. Now he is facing the south direction. In which direction does he start to cycle from his home? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: All turns are 90 degree turns only.

As to find the starting direction, solving in the reverse order:

1) Now he is facing the south direction.→ Facing north

2) From the square, again he takes a left and covers 2 kilometres. → covers a distance of 2 km to the square and then takes a right

3) Then he turns left and cycles 5 kilometres to reach a square. → from square covers a distance of 5 km and then turns right.

4) Sohan starts from his home and cycles 2 kilometres on a straight road. → covers a distance of 2 km in a straight road to Sohan's home.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4d42b9da89158acb176f49c61cbfcf2af1057a0c5537ea1d1f5218157b4da90.png] 

 

Thus, Sohan starts from the north direction to cycle from his home.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
